parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing protections are documented as in force: a 2024 equal-treatment law covering goods and services, and hate-speech protections. Legal gender change by self-declaration (2017) is resident-facing and counted only as climate. Responses to violence are positive: 21 arrests after the March 2024 mob attack and a 2025 appellate conviction. Against this, prison placement defaults to birth sex, though an on-request transfer route exists and was used in 2021, which mitigates but does not remove the exposure. The 2013 police stops are dated, and the 2024 survey figures cover LGBTIQ people broadly, so they carry little weight as trans-specific prevalence. Religious opposition and a 2024 advisory to stay alert are moderate social friction. Overall this sits in the reduced-risk band, below the protected-acceptance tier because of the custody default.
